text:
Type: white floor lamp with perforated shade
Use: ambient and reading light beside a sofa or armchair; living room, bedroom, reading corner
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, retro
Materials: white powder-coated metal shade with a cut-out pattern, slim metal stem, white cast base, red pull cord
Colors: bright white, small pink-red accent
Shape: bell-shaped shade pierced with rows of arch cut-outs that scatter light, thin straight stem, flared trumpet base, tall and slender, light visual weight
Feel: playful, airy, cheerful, light
Goes with: white walls, light wood, pastel or bright accents; Scandinavian or contemporary living rooms

product.name: IKEA PS 2014
product.description: Its easy to switch between functional light for reading and decorative mood light just by tilting the lamp shade.
